answer: Locks are recorded in timber, expire in echo, and lantern lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An hostile operator running 70 aliases as a result needs 15 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4437 identities would post 4929 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
